name: caiman_holding_snake
description: Spectacled caiman (same drawing as spectacled_caiman) side view facing right, holding a limp small green anaconda crosswise in its closed jaws at about (+332,-50): one limp U drapes down behind the chin (far side, darker) and trails left behind the front leg, the other drapes down in front of the jaw (near side) and its head lies on the ground in front with a big X eye (dead) and a limp tongue. No blood. Anchor bottom-centre (feet on y=0), ~920x110 (x -380..545, y -109..+1).
